definitions.gloss: unopened, sealed, still in original packaging
definitions.explanation: Describes a product or container that has not been opened from its original sealed state.

examples.japanese: {未開封|みかいふう}の{商品|しょうひん}のみ{返品|へんぴん}{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: Only unopened items can be returned.

examples.japanese: この{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}は{未開封|みかいふう}なら{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{持|も}つ。
examples.english: This milk will keep for a week if left unopened.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{入|い}れから{未開封|みかいふう}のまま{忘|わす}れられていた{荷物|にもつ}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: A package that had been forgotten while still unopened came out of the closet.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{未|み} (not yet) + {開封|かいふう} (opening a seal). The prefix {未|み}～ indicates something has not yet been done.

CONTRAST:
- {未開封|みかいふう}: unopened
- {開封|かいふう}{済|ず}み: already opened

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {未開封|みかいふう}の{場合|ばあい}: in the case of being unopened
- {未開封|みかいふう}のまま: while still unopened
- {未開封|みかいふう}{品|ひん}: unopened item
